sources.entry: Gooba - Writing app and task manager with a simple and interactive design.

summary.name: Gooba
summary.one_liner: Gooba is a notes and task manager app with Markdown editing, a simple interactive design, and a one-off paid upgrade tier.
use_cases: writing from an iPad with an external keyboard
checking grammar while writing with Grammarly
exporting notes to PDF or plain text
summary.what_it_does: Gooba combines a note-writing app and a task manager in one place so separate apps are not needed. It has a Markdown editor and keyboard shortcuts, which the page says make writing from an iPad with an external keyboard similar to using a computer. The free plan includes unlimited notes and tasks, priority notes, recovery of deleted notes, export to PDF and txt, and a dashboard. The paid one-off upgrade adds folders, protected notes, Markdown and HTML export, more than two task groups, scheduled tasks, reminders, This week and This month tabs, notes-in-tasks linking, an Apple Watch app, universal search, and dark and black modes. The page also says it is compatible with Grammarly (which requires a Grammarly Premium subscription, with a 30-day trial via ThomsonShore).
notable: Markdown editor with keyboard shortcuts for iPad external keyboards
Notes and tasks combined in one app, including notes in tasks and tasks in notes
Grammarly compatibility for grammar checking while writing
Free plan with unlimited notes and tasks; one-off $7.99 upgrade
caveats: Advanced features require the paid one-off upgrade at $7.99
Grammarly checking needs a separate Grammarly Premium subscription
Platform list is inferred from the page's iPad and Apple Watch mentions; the page does not explicitly list macOS support
